ct_distant_progression==1.reason: Distant metastatic progression on CT: watch-and-wait contraindicated

bx_result==positive.reason: Positive biopsy: residual viable tumor confirmed histologically

endo_finding==visible_tumor.reason: Visible tumor on endoscopy: macroscopic residual disease

dre_finding==palpable_mass.reason: Palpable mass on DRE: residual bulky disease

data.note: safe_for_watch_and_wait = 1 requires local complete response (residual_tumor = 0) and no distant progression (ct_distant_progression = 0). The 38 patients with local complete response but distant progression are correctly excluded by the CT hard stop.

full.score_note: Rule-based NOT COMPLETE rows are assigned score 0 for ranking metrics; calibration figures use the ML subset.

ml.score_note: Pure model probabilities on the hard-stop-eligible subset.

baselines.B0_note: Majority class from the training split; no model, no abstention.
baselines.B1_note: Simple rule protocol: mrTRG <= 2, DRE scar/no abnormality, endoscopy scar, biopsy not positive, CT no distant progression. No abstention.
baselines.B2_note: Logistic regression on 8 hand-picked features; trained on the training ML split; no abstention at threshold 0.5.

dre.note: Deployed policy forces UNCERTAIN for 83 non-hard-stopped patients; deployed COMPLETE calls = 0.

endoscopy.note: Deployed policy forces UNCERTAIN for 83 non-hard-stopped patients; deployed COMPLETE calls = 0.

biopsy.note: Deployed policy forces UNCERTAIN for 83 non-hard-stopped patients; deployed COMPLETE calls = 0.

mri.note: Deployed policy forces UNCERTAIN for 79 non-hard-stopped patients; deployed COMPLETE calls = 0.

ct.note: Deployed policy forces UNCERTAIN for 87 non-hard-stopped patients; deployed COMPLETE calls = 0. Model-only path would call 4 of 8 distant-progression patients COMPLETE.

noise.model: Gaussian noise at 0.2x training SD on mri_ADC_mean and mri_wall_thickness_mm; 10% label flip on mri_DWI_restriction.
noise.note: ML subset. Model-only ignores the missing-exam policy; deployed applies it. Noise alone does not create missing key exams, so the policy does not block on noise alone.

extra_missingness.model: Each ML feature is independently set missing with probability 0.2.
extra_missingness.note: ML subset. The deployed policy forces UNCERTAIN when a key exam column is missing; the model-only path imputes and continues.

leakage_checks.note: ct_distant_progression is a Layer 1 rule input and is deliberately excluded from the ML feature matrix.

full.score_note: Rule-based NOT COMPLETE rows are assigned score 0 for ranking metrics; calibration figures use the ML subset.

ml.score_note: Pure model probabilities on the hard-stop-eligible subset.
